description: This file defines data structures and classes for representing Wi-Fi 6 capabilities in a TLV (Type-Length-Value) format, including classes like 'tlvApWifi6Capabilities', 'cRole', and various bitfield structures for flags.

classes.name: tlvApWifi6Capabilities
classes.description: Class representing Wi-Fi 6 Capabilities TLV with fields for type, radio ID, number of roles, and role data.

classes.name: cRole
classes.description: Class modeling a role with support flags and MCS/NSS configurations, dynamically sized based on 'number_of_roles'.

classes.name: sFlags1
classes.description: Bitfield structure representing agent role and support flags for 160MHz and 80+80MHz operations.

classes.name: sFlags2
classes.description: Bitfield structure with boolean flags for beamforming, MU-MIMO, and OFDMA capabilities.

classes.name: sFlags3
classes.description: Bitfield for maximum DL and UL MU-MIMO transmission and reception levels.

classes.name: sFlags4
classes.description: Flags related to RTS, MU RTS, multi BSSID, EDCA, TWT, and spatial reuse features.
